summary: Hook and launcher audit: brief F5 asks for an audit table and covers the pre-commit hook, the npm launcher, the eval scripts and the skill examples. The repository has no audit table; atip.codeexit.11 scans only the hook and the launcher for a comparison with 1. I checked the rest at 26cb75b5: the hook and the launcher block or pass on any non-zero exit, evals/*.py, scripts/*.py, justfile and .github/ compare exit codes only with `!= 0`, so nothing depends on exit 1 of a changed code, but the scan in the test does not read evals or scripts and its pattern would miss `= 1` and `case 1)`. Add the audit rows to the change (or to the CHANGELOG) and extend the scan to evals/ and scripts/.
